title: Walk cycle: front view, camera dollies back
description: Front-view companion to the side track: the camera dollies back at his walking speed while he walks toward it, constant framing, grid floor receding.

body.subject: This armoured warrior, exactly as in [start_image]: {{design_lock}}.
body.action: He walks straight toward the camera at a steady natural pace of {{cadence_spm}} steps per minute, {{gait_notes}}, arms swinging opposite the legs.
body.camera: Front-on dolly back: the camera dollies backward at exactly his walking speed, keeping him centred with constant framing and constant scale, medium-long lens, eye level at hip height.
body.style: Even flat studio light; flat light-grey studio floor marked with a regular square grid of thin dark lines; plain light-grey backdrop. The grid recedes behind the camera as it moves.
body.constraints: Full body always in frame with margin, feet visible on the floor, exactly two arms and two legs, same armour design throughout.

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

gait_notes.default: heel strike to toe-off with the weight shifting smoothly

start_image.description: the full-body front view in the start pose

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken

gates.description: anim_check: fraction of frames with the body tracked
